entities.summary: Eliezer Toledano is an Israeli Aluf who served as the commander of the Paratroopers Brigade, the Military Secretary to the Prime Minister, the commander of the Gaza Division, the commander of the Southern Command and head of the Strategy and Third-Circle Directorate of the General Staff of the Israel Defense Forces until it was closed in 2025.
